name: pdfly
description: PDFly - all your PDF tools in one place, entirely in the browser. Merge, split, compress, convert, edit and organize PDFs.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/pdf-core && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/pdf-core && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/pdf-core && npm run test -w client
